facts: Rust 1.98.1 fixes a rustc miscompilation in trait-object vtable generation.
Rust 1.98.0 could emit a null pointer where a function pointer belonged, causing undefined behavior.
Update stable toolchains with rustup update stable if they use Rust 1.98.0.
stories.title: Rust 1.98.1 is out
stories.whyItMatters: Correctness and safety fix: update CI and developer toolchains using Rust 1.98.0.

facts: NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9303bn: $11.9bn purchase price plus up to $1bn in employee retention awards.
The deal is expected to close in H1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
Hugging Face says it will remain open, multi-cloud and multi-accelerator; NVIDIA hardware will not be required.
NVIDIA says the platform has 18m+ users, 3m+ models, 500,000 datasets and 1m applications.
stories.title: NVIDIA agrees to acquire Hugging Face
stories.whyItMatters: NVIDIA is moving up the stack into model distribution and developer workflow; the open-platform promise is the key thing to watch after closing.

stories.title: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber
facts: Gemini 3.8 Flash targets software engineering, agentic workflows and multi-step reasoning.
Introductory API price: $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens through 31 Dec 2026.
Available via Gemini API, AI Studio, Android Studio, Antigravity, Stitch, Gemini Enterprise and to Pro/Ultra users.
Flash Cyber targets vulnerability discovery and automated patching; access is limited to trusted defenders through Fairwind.
stories.whyItMatters: Google is packaging stronger long-horizon coding and defensive security capability at Flash pricing.

stories.title: ChatGPT, Claude and Grok fail at once
facts: OpenAI, Anthropic and X confirmed outages on 3 September, alongside a spike in DownDetector reports.
Cursor also reported an outage tied to the Claude and Grok failures.
9to5Google notes all three use Microsoft Azure among their cloud providers; Azure also saw a report spike.
No confirmed root cause or restoration time was available at publication; Gemini appeared unaffected.
stories.whyItMatters: A shared dependency can turn separate AI products into one incident surface; Azure was a possibility, not a confirmed cause.

stories.title: DLSS 5 is RTX 50-only
facts: NVIDIA confirmed DLSS 5 runs on Blackwell fifth-generation Tensor cores with no supported RTX 40-or-older fallback.
The neural-rendering stage adds learned lighting and material appearance while preserving game geometry and silhouettes.
DLSS 5 launched with NBA 2K27 and supports RTX 50 GPUs, RTX 50 laptops and GeForce NOW.
Modders have forced leaked code onto older cards, but that is not NVIDIA-supported compatibility.
stories.whyItMatters: Official DLSS 5 support requires Blackwell, even though unofficial experiments show older cards can execute the code.

image.alt: DLSS 5 technical preview rendered game scene

stories.title: Neovim 0.13 gets native multiple cursors
facts: Multiple cursors landed in Neovim core in PR #41587 and are scheduled for Neovim 0.13.
The feature is in Nightly at the time of the guide.
Q adds cursors, 1Q places one at every search match, and visual selections can create one per line.
stories.whyItMatters: A long-standing plugin workflow is moving into core while keeping Vim-style commands and registers.
